Recommend engineering review a source-name crosswalk and parent/tier correction candidate.

findings.uncertainty: No legally authoritative boundary or alias evidence retained; Doutsita may be variant spelling or source error. Do not change ID/name/parent or certify geometry from this packet.

Equatorial Guinea Government memorial to ICJ describes Elobey Chico as an island in Cogo District, Litoral Province. Recommend engineering review tier/parent crosswalk and island purpose; no geometry correction is authorized.

The 28-feature source cannot demonstrate current roster, current boundary, or tier placement. Restore current legal acts and official roster/boundaries.

findings.subject: Inter-region island parent and source-code crosswalk
findings.finding: Scope includes five Gulf of Guinea Islands members and source rows use multiple internal area codes; both Elobey features are source GNQ but have baseline area code GAB. Island spellings and jurisdiction/parent purposes require a coordinated neighboring-scope source crosswalk before any shared-parent/source-predecessor edit.
evidence: Equatorial Guinea ICJ memorial reference above
findings.uncertainty: Internal area codes are application metadata, not evidence of national ownership or administrative placement. No outer scope move recommended.

findings.subject: Province and area coverage
findings.finding: All 227 exact IDs resolve to the pinned baseline and native source features; all 38 scoped province groups and five area groups are enumerated with exact descendant location IDs. Area membership was reconstructed from baseline parent links and matches the issue-pinned counts. Of 227, 225 are insufficient-evidence and two have bounded correction-needed findings. WGSRPD defines country-level-and-upward units for recording plant distributions; its Botanical Country level may ignore purely political factors, so the source purpose does not by itself certify these as general-purpose atlas areas.
findings.uncertainty: Exact area membership has been recovered but the issue packet still lacks evidence establishing appropriate atlas semantic purpose, boundary correspondence, and resolution of neighboring crosswalk disagreements.

findings.subject: Multipart source geometry screening
findings.finding: Pinned source geometry contains multipart Cogo (4 components), Elobey Grande (2), Annobón (2), and Bendjè (2). The Government memorial locates Corisco and both Elobey islands within Cogo District. Reconcile the islands to legally sourced roles/parents and inspect Cogo’s components in its source context; Bendjè’s components also need local administrative interpretation. #869 includes Cogo and all five scoped Gulf-island area members; #871 covers the Doutsita/Doutsila location only.
findings.uncertainty: A multipart polygon can be islands, coastal parts, topology artefacts or separate territorial components. Component count and bounding boxes do not establish legal or physical interpretation. Restore the exact ICJ source and authoritative boundary/roster before any correction.
